wizard.step1: Choose a plan. Zero Trust Free is available at $0/seat/month with a 50-seat limit.
wizard.step2: Activate Zero Trust Free. A payment card is required even on the Free plan, plus acceptance of terms and authorization for usage-based overage charges.
wizard.teamName: Not requested in the live wizard; set after activation under Zero Trust > Settings > Team name and domain.

blocker: Enabling Access Free requires a card on file and authorization for monthly overage charges. That conflicts with the approved no-billing and $0 fixed-cost boundaries.
actionTaken: Wizard inspected only. Checkout was exited without submitting. No Zero Trust organization or subscription was created; the account remains unchanged.
approvalNeeded: Explicit approval to add/confirm a payment method for the Free plan, or a decision to defer Access and use the server-side admin token for Phase 0A.
